A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bpfasshi/Legends|Bpfasshi]] was the '''leader''' of a group of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] during the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic]]. He was the cause of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] energies and phenomena that would occurred in what became known as the [[Cave of Evil/Legends|Dark Side Cave]] on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].

==Biography==
The group was pursued in [[700 BBY]] by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] team. In a [[Cave of Evil/Legends|cave]] on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], he was confronted by [[Minch (Jedi)|Minch]], who was eager to fight the humanoid and prove his mettle. The Bpfasshi mocked Minch, calling him a "small child" and scolded him for his anger and weakness. Enraged, Minch defiantly replied "Size matters not!" and [[Duel on Dagobah (700 BBY)|attacked]]. The Dark Jedi quickly repulsed the attack and replied that size indeed mattered.<ref name="HOD" />

[[File:Pursuit-HeartOfDarkness.jpg|thumb|left|250px]]
Apparently changing his form into hundreds of smaller incarnations of himself, the Dark Jedi enveloped Minch, who desperately lashed out with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. When Minch recovered, the Dark Jedi was mortally injured, and told him he had potential as a Dark Jedi.<ref name="HOD" /> His blood seeped into the cave floor as he died,<ref name="HOD" /> and caused the many [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] energies and phenomena that occurred in what became known as the Dark Side Cave many years later.<ref name="HOTE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>
